meta.title: Adapter Health Lifecycle — DOWN Streaks, Alerts and Recovery

views.label: Building the streak
views.note: Two DOWNs stay amber; the third crosses the threshold.

views.label: One alert per streak
views.note: Further DOWNs keep counting without raising a second alert.

views.label: Recovery and replays
views.note: Any UP resets the streak and closes the alert.

transitions.note: Exactly one alert per streak; its id derives from the triggering event id
alertActive stays true while consecutiveDown keeps growing

transitions.label: UP
transitions.note: The alert closes; a later streak alerts again

cards.title: Threshold
items: Two DOWNs stay amber without an alert
The third raises exactly one alert per streak
AdapterHealth.observe returns the next state plus an optional alert

cards.title: Suppression
items: A 4th or later DOWN keeps counting the streak
alertActive stays true, so no second alert is derived
DEGRADED observations leave both counters untouched

cards.title: Recovery and replays
items: Any UP resets the streak and closes the alert
Alert ids derive from the trigger, so replays never duplicate one
The aggregate is immutable: every observation returns a new state
